tasks.title: Fresh inventory, policy, baseline, and harness
Freeze the API through consumer-first design probes
Immutable feature contracts and compatibility lowering
Scoped surface instances, ownership, and registry lifecycle
Scope activation, safe workspace transitions, and draft guards
Local data convenience and update correctness
Remote data, coverage, caching, and semantic correctness
One deterministic adaptive decision engine
Registered views, bounded composition, and state transfer
Workspace-wide adaptive presentation without tenancy changes
React DX, native custom views, and headless consumption
Host actions and a genuine non-data feature
SSR, hydration, framework and islands compatibility
Accessible and predictable adaptive experience
Optional scoped agent bridge and truthful receipts
Protocol-based BYOK and provider conformance
Threat model, authority, retention, and abuse limits
Every component documented and copyable examples verified
Four cross-domain reference journeys and value comparison
Bundle, latency, heap, and module-scale qualification
Packaging, migrations, and qualified support
Full review, candidate, and authorized release

requirements.requirement: Fresh checkout, active policy, toolchain, catalog, and baseline recorded
No-AI standalone and adaptive paths work without model imports/requests
Public DX has small typed APIs; no giant all-props component or config
Features are immutable definitions; data and identities are scoped bindings
Multiple instances of one feature are independent and explicitly addressed
Lifecycle survives Strict Mode, interrupted render, unmount, and disposal
Controlled host state cannot be bypassed by UI or agent requests
Local data updates retain controller identity and bounded resource use
Remote queries preserve coverage, pagination, unsupported capabilities
requirements.required_evidence: Real protocol fixture and query assertions

requirements.requirement: Analytics respects grain, units, ratios, time, nulls, and partial data
Same normalized inputs yield the same resolver result and explanation
Eligibility, pins, ambiguity, fallback, and composition are explicit
Existing host UI and native React custom views work without remount hacks
Writes retain preview, confirmation, authorization, idempotency, ambiguity
requirements.required_evidence: Server-side action integration and restart/retry cases

requirements.requirement: Non-relational/editor/job feature uses capabilities without fake table data
SSR has meaningful initial content and matching safe hydration
Framework-independent paths and support matrix are honestly qualified
UX preserves work and exposes all important states accessibly
Theme, locale, RTL, time, reduced motion, zoom, and expansion work
Agent connection is optional, scoped, authenticated, and cancellable
BYOK uses protocol capabilities, not hardcoded vendor/model selection
requirements.required_evidence: Model conformance profiles and secret scan

requirements.requirement: Model/provider quality is separated from mock protocol compatibility
Permissions, egress, prompt injection, forged receipts are contained
Every catalog component has accurate standalone/semantic/adaptive docs
Every advertised copyable code example typechecks in its declared environment and key examples run from tarballs
requirements.required_evidence: Generated docs consumer and browser preview tests

requirements.requirement: Product value is shown across distinct application classes
Bundle, work, latency, memory, and module scaling meet measured budgets
Large apps use scoped registries/lazy loading, not global eager imports
Versioned public APIs/protocols/migrations and old consumers are covered
Existing full quality matrix stays enforced with new gates added
requirements.required_evidence: Fresh `pnpm check` on accepted unchanged source

requirements.requirement: Publish and deploy are separately authorized, verified, and recoverable
Checkpoints preserve decisions, failures, and remaining work
requirements.required_evidence: Continuously updated execution state and task ledger

requirements.requirement: No duplicate authority/query/business-state engine introduced
requirements.required_evidence: Dependency review and existing/new path parity tests

requirements.requirement: Rate, concurrency, cancellation, retention, and quotas remain bounded
Progress/results/diagnostics never imply success without actual receipts
No unsupported claim of unlimited scale or every framework/provider
Application scope switching is isolated, stale-safe, and has explicit state portability rules
requirements.required_evidence: Workspace A→B transition, late-result, cache/cursor/action-revocation tests

requirements.requirement: Agent context follows the current trusted scope without allowing the model to choose or reuse another scope
requirements.required_evidence: Mid-request workspace switch, rebind, cross-scope metadata/tool-result tests

requirements.requirement: Voluntary scope changes guard unsaved work; forced invalidation fences access without carrying drafts
requirements.required_evidence: Save/Discard/Stay, failed save, forced logout and scoped recovery tests

requirements.requirement: Old controller callbacks and A-B-A activations cannot retarget a new scope
requirements.required_evidence: Monotonic activation and immutable surface-generation/address race tests

requirements.requirement: Workspace-wide layouts adapt coherently without changing tenancy or duplicating controllers
requirements.required_evidence: Single/split/compare, child-failure, stale-read-set and real-DOM composition tests

requirements.requirement: Browser/server transport and rendering boundaries resist credential, CSRF, XSS and cache leakage
requirements.required_evidence: SSR escaping, origin checks, cookie mutation, session/bfcache and cross-principal fixtures

requirements.requirement: Cache/cursor semantics separate value identity and freshness from active UI fencing
requirements.required_evidence: A-B-A reauthorization, live/snapshot pagination and no-per-render cache explosion tests

requirements.requirement: Agent pairing and conversation/continuation state are isolated by scope and target
requirements.required_evidence: Outbound payload audit, old continuation rejection and explicit target allowlists

requirements.requirement: One consistent API contract and non-vacuous consumer tests replace conflicting chat examples
requirements.required_evidence: Positive/negative installed consumers, immutable target types, visible SSR DOM proof

requirements.requirement: Final handoff, migration and export/entry documentation refer to the same version and requirements
requirements.required_evidence: Manifest, task graph, public export/docs mapping and checkpoint migration checks
